summary: Verified the /admin/school-payments routing fix. Both scenarios pass: (1) Direct navigation to /admin/school-payments (no schoolId) correctly redirects to /admin/orders and lands on the 'School Payments' tab which is active (orange highlight, data-testid='school-payments-tab' visible). (2) /admin/school-payments/{schoolId} still renders the SchoolPaymentTracker detail page with 'School - Payment Tracker' header and stats cards (empty state 'No payments found' shown for the test UUID, which is acceptable). No 404 detected in either case.
critical_code_review_comments: Route /admin/school-payments is a public Navigate (not wrapped in ProtectedRoute). This is fine because /admin/orders itself is protected, so unauthenticated hits still get redirected to login after the internal navigate — no security concern, just a note.

AdminOrders.jsx is 3357 lines — exceeds the recommended 700-line limit. Consider splitting into per-tab sub-components (SchoolPaymentsTab, StudentPaymentsTab, etc.) for maintainability. Not blocking, but worth planning.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Routing fix in /app/frontend/src/App.js line 273 verified working. /admin/school-payments -> Navigate replace to /admin/orders. AdminOrders defaults activeTab='school' so the School Payments tab is auto-active on redirect. Detail route /admin/school-payments/:schoolId still loads SchoolPaymentTracker correctly.
rca of the issue: Root cause: React Router had only /admin/school-payments/:schoolId defined; the base path /admin/school-payments matched no route so RouteNotFound rendered a 404. Fix: added <Route path='/admin/school-payments' element={<Navigate to='/admin/orders' replace />} /> at line 273 of App.js before the parametrized route. Verified via Playwright: URL redirects to /admin/orders, school-payments-tab is visible & active.
